faq.q: Can a first-time buyer avoid property transfer tax on a townhome on this page?
faq.a: On price alone, in the lower part of the band: the first time home buyers' program exempts a qualifying purchaser on the first $500,000 of the purchase price, its full exemption requires a fair market value of $835,000 or less and a partial exemption may apply to $860,000 — townhomes above $860,000 are outside it on price, though the program's other conditions still have to be met either way.
